; File: radius_f.ana ; Created: Wed, Nov 30 1994, 13:14:52 ; Author: mats@astro.su.se ; Returns a 2r x 2r matrix with the radial coordinates of each pixel ; as measured from the origin in pixel (r,r). The value is unity at ; the distance r_c from the origin. ; Ported from ANA function red_radial_coordinate,r,r_c,xOffset=xOffset,yOffset=yOffset if n_elements(xOffset) eq 0 then xOffset = 0 if n_elements(yOffset) eq 0 then yOffset = 0 x = red_horizontal_coordinate(r,r_c,xOffset=xOffset) y = transpose(red_horizontal_coordinate(r,r_c,xOffset=yOffset)) rr = sqrt(x*x+y*y) x = 0 ; Save space! y = 0 return, rr end
